name: Werne Claudius
original_name: ヴェルナー・クラウディウス
source:
Werne is the prince of the kingdom and heir to the throne. He has lived an isolated and sheltered life, receiving anything he wished at his beck and call. Now he has become a spoiled and selfish individual, who longs to be away from the castle and see the world, instead of feeling like a prisoner within the safety of the palace. However, his attitude often gets him into trouble.
